'''Kwilaan''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], located near a [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] operative [[Raymas Daal]] held a meeting in a [[Kwilaan restaurant]] with a group of agents to hire them to [[Attack on the Kwilaan sensor array|attack]] the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]]. The meeting was interrupted by [[Security Officer]]s of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], who failed to capture Daal and were dealt with by the agents afterward.

==Description==
Kwilaan was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It contained a [[Kwilaan restaurant|small restaurant]], and a [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]] was located near the city.<ref name="SI" /> The settlement shared its name with [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]], the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who first [[Star map/Legends|charted]] the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] and guided the first [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] to the world.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Come with me, Daal, I've got a few questions.|A Royal Naboo Security Forces agent, to Daal in Kwilaan|<ref name="SI" />}}
[[File:Kwilaan_restaurant.png|thumb|right|250px|The restaurant in Kwilaan]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which includes the attack on the Kwilaan [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]], in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] planned to temporarily deactivate the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] near Kwilaan in order to place [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] in preparation for its upcoming [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Trade Federation operative and small-time criminal [[Raymas Daal]] was hired to arrange the [[Attack on the Kwilaan sensor array|attack]] on the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array without revealing his connection to the corporation. Daal arranged a meeting with a group of agents in a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] in Kwilaan.<ref name="SI" />

{{RPGseed}}
The agents arrived first and were about to give up on the meeting when Daal appeared, hoping for a quick meeting in the belief that he had been followed. The agents and Daal made arrangements for the attack to take place the following [[Local day/Legends|night]] and negotiated the hiring fee. Daal claimed that he would be able to detect the sensor array's deactivation and land his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in Kwilaan afterward. As the meeting was about to conclude, three [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Security Officer]]s entered the restaurant. When their leader ordered Daal to come with them, the criminal escaped through the back door instead. The [[Officer/Legends|officers]] fired at Daal with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and one of them turned their [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] towards the agents. The agents dealt with the officers and successfully completed the attack on the sensor array as planned.<ref name="SI" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kwilaan was mentioned in "[[Signal Interruption]]," an adventure scenario for the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game]]'' written by [[Jesse Decker]]. The scenario was published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s website on [[August 9]], [[2001]]. In "Signal Interruption," the players control the agents hired by Daal to attack the sensor array near Kwilaan. These can include the playable characters from the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'': [[Dané]], [[Galak]], [[Rann I-Kanu]], [[Arani Korden]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Deel Surool]], [[Toba]], and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]]. The scenario consists of three encounters, the first two of which take place inside the restaurant in Kwilaan, with the game master using pieces from the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'' to represent the building.<ref name="SI" />
